rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides access to CTFd (Capture The Flag) platforms for cybersecurity competitions and training. This Python implementation supports multiple authentication methods (API tokens, session cookies, username/password) and handles various dynamic container backends including ctfd-whale, ctfd-owl, and Kubernetes-based deployments. The server enables browsing challenges, retrieving detailed descriptions and files, submitting flags, and managing dynamic instances across different CTFd plugin ecosystems.
